messages:
maya (VP People): Quick follow-up on today's all-hands re: hiring & org adjustments. Keeping this thread short for Qs.

sam (CTO): Context: 28 net new roles this FY. Priority = runtime + infra to improve latency and reliability.

lisa (People Ops): Q2 hiring burst: ~20 prioritized roles. Recruit templates + rubrics will be posted in #recruiting today.

jordan (eng-manager): Which teams exactly get Q2 hires? need to plan interview panels.

maya (VP People): Q2 allocation: eng-runtime 10, eng-infra/eng-sre 6, devex/docs 4. 4 reserve for customer needs.

nina (IC): Any layoffs or involuntary changes tied to this?

maya (VP People): No involuntary layoffs. This is consolidation of reporting lines to reduce duplicated efforts.

lisa (People Ops): Target SLA req->offer: 6-8w senior, 4-6w mid/junior. We'll share a read-only pipeline tracker (no PII).

harper (allhands-bot): :calendar: Event created: "Hiring sprint Q&A" Fri 10:00 6 maya, sam, lisa.

maya (VP People): We'll publish a before/after team map and manager talking points by EOD Thursday. DM Lisa or me for sensitive concerns.

sam (CTO): Short-term oncall doesn't change; new hires will shadow. We'll add SRE headcount if pager metrics don't improve.

jordan (eng-manager): Thanks 6 will review rubrics when posted and flag stage bottlenecks.

nina (IC): Request: public read-only list of open reqs + stage would be helpful.

lisa (People Ops): Agreed 6 link in #recruiting tomorrow.

maya (VP People): Appreciate everyone's patience. We're aiming for a phased, coordinated ramp. :sparkles:
